observations: Photo 0, 1, and 2 show the same industrial sewing machine on a white table with a foot pedal and power switch.
The machine has a beige body with a red oval 'Emel' logo on the head.
A black thread spool is mounted on a stand above the machine.
Yellow scissors are placed on the table next to the machine.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some scuffs and dirt visible on the body.
The foot pedal is connected to the machine via a cable.
The table has a ruler along the front edge.
The floor is black marble with white veining.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DEBISPAK' is overlaid on all photos.

claims.claim: Emel industrial sewing machine in a very good condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear and dirt, but no functional test is shown. The condition is subjective and not proven by the photos alone.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal wear not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video of the machine running under load, including needle movement, thread tension, and motor operation.

risks.risk: Missing parts or accessories (e.g., presser foot, bobbins, foot pedal adjustment, or power cord).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues or damaged power cord or plug.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the power cord and plug, showing no fraying or damage.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running under load.
Photo showing all included accessories and parts.
Close-up photo of the power cord and plug.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
